monitoring-bot: ALERT: unusual export volume from prod-db.users — 58GB exported in last 10m. Query fingerprint: COPY users TO 's3://redwood-exports/prod/2026-03-19/users.csv' — src ip 54.123.45.67
alyssa (sec-eng): seeing this now. tagging devon +sam. is this scheduled job?
devon (db-eng): not scheduled. checking pg_stat_activity and audit. running: `SELECT pid, usename, client_addr, query, query_start FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%COPY%users%';`
devon (db-eng): result -> pid 8421 user analytics_service client 54.123.45.67 query_start '2026-03-19 16:11:22 UTC' query: `COPY (SELECT id, email, created_at FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01') TO PROGRAM 'aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-exports/prod/2026-03-19/users.csv' WITH CSV`
alyssa (sec-eng): that service account shouldn't have export rights. checking IAM/roles. sam, can you block the egress and revoke keys for analytics_service?
sam (oncall): on it. disabling role session and removing IAM policy now: `aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name analytics_service --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess`
sam (oncall): also rotating credentials: `aws iam delete-access-key --access-key-id AKIA...`
kevin (infra): blocking outbound to S3 from the DB subnet via NACL while we investigate. applied temporary deny. confirmation: outbound 443 blocked for that subnet.
devon (db-eng): captured audit log lines from pgaudit: `user=analytics_service action=COPY target=users bytes=61362345 src_ip=54.123.45.67 time=2026-03-19T16:11:22Z`
alyssa (sec-eng): good. can we pull the export manifest from the bucket and snapshot for forensics? auditor-bot, please record chain of custody.
auditor-bot: FOR-ENTRY: bucket s3://redwood-exports/prod/2026-03-19/ users.csv hash sha256: 3a7f... archived to secure-forensics.
mira (comms): heads up — need to prepare internal incident note and see if customer-facing notice required. what data columns are in file?
devon (db-eng): exported columns: id, email, created_at. no PII beyond email. running quick sample to count distinct emails and check for known test accounts.
devon (db-eng): distinct_emails = 1,234,567. appears to be full user export.
alyssa (sec-eng): classification = user_contact_data. legal on call? if no SSN, low-high sensitivity depends on customer contracts. tagging compliance later.
sam (oncall): containment done: role disabled, creds rotated, network egress blocked, bucket access logs enabled. leaving export object intact for forensic.
kevin (infra): KMS note: object was encrypted with customer-managed key kms://alias/redwood-prod-s3. we should rotate and revoke grant to analytics_service. running: `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id 5a4b... --key-id alias/redwood-prod-s3`
alys sa (typo) -> (ignore)
alyssa (sec-eng): action items for now: 1) forensic snapshot (devon/auditor-bot) 2) preserve logs (kevin) 3) update runbook to disallow direct COPY TO from DB -> S3 (sam/infra) 4) RBAC review for analytics_service (alyssa/devon)
devon (db-eng): quick check of role history: last IAM policy change for analytics_service was 2026-03-10 by ops-deploy-bot via terraform. possible drift during a recent rollout.
alyssa (sec-eng): ok, raise a PR to lock exports behind a controlled lambda that enforces allowlist and MFA for exports. also add threshold alerts for export size and rate.
mira (comms): drafting internal note. do we need to notify customers? will confirm after legal. ETA 2h.
kevin (infra): enabling longer retention for audit logs + add immutable storage for 30d for forensics.
sam (oncall): running post-incident quick checks: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01';` vs export row count. rows match export size.
devon (db-eng): list of suspected IPs: 54.123.45.67 (export agent), 18.204.12.9 (failed attempts). creating blocklist.
alyssa (sec-eng): preliminary severity: P3 (internal data exposure to party with credentials). escalate to P2 if legal says notify customers.
mira (comms): noted. I'll ping legal.
auditor-bot: LOG: Incident recorded incident_id=INC-2026-0319-01, timeline started=1712130000, current state=containment.
alyssa (sec-eng): postmortem actions: - enforce least-privilege for analytics_service - require explicit export job registration in ops repo - add automated pre-export approval for >10MB exports - add RBAC change alerts to slack #eng-security - KMS grant audit weekly
sam (oncall): can someone take ownership of the postmortem? I'll handle runbook updates. alyssa, can you own RBAC policy diff and PR?
alyssa (sec-eng): yes I'll own RBAC review and PR. devon please revert the terraform drift and pin role policies.
devon (db-eng): will do. creating PR now: `tf change: lock analytics_service policies`
mira (comms): internal note ready for execs (sensitive). awaiting legal signoff for customer notice.
alyssa (sec-eng): thanks all. follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 to review playbook changes and alert tuning. :thumbsup:
